tools.name: qualify_task
tools.description: Preferred read-only first action whenever a buyer provides one sanitized expected-versus-actual need, including after list_offers. Returns the smallest matching fixed-price offer, a broader-service route, or a scope-reduction decision; it performs no diagnosis, retains no request text, and creates n

tools.name: acknowledge_purchase_offer
tools.description: Records that an agent actually received and retained one exact offer. A durable return method, operator linkage, and delegated limits are optional and recorded only when truthfully supplied. Receipt-only acknowledgement creates no order, grants no authority, stores no callback URL, and never proves

tools.name: preflight_agent_purchase
tools.description: Read-only transaction check. Verifies product match, credential, standing agent policy or narrower signed mandate, exact offer allowlist, price ceiling, current terms, sanitized scope, capacity, and payment-route readiness. It creates no intent, checkout, charge, order, or telemetry event.

tools.name: resume_agent_purchase
tools.description: Read-only durable continuation. Returns the exact observed stop and next executable action for a previously returned opaque continuation token. It creates no purchase, checkout, charge, or order.

tools.name: find_service
tools.description: Optional demand-feedback route. Describe one authorized sanitized business need once. Zinvyl returns the best fixed-scope offer and next purchase action, or records an unsupported need as privacy-minimized product telemetry. For read-only matching, start with qualify_task.

tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: Use when comparing Zinvyl's full eleven-option catalog. For a single sanitized need, start with read-only qualify_task. Returns price, delivery window, required inputs, exclusions, and direct intake URL; use get_acceptance_tests only after selecting an offer.

tools.name: get_purchase_requirements
tools.description: Use after selecting an offer. Returns the exact price, five-field buy_service contract, delegated-authority requirements, machine-payment route, capacity limits, and authoritative funding rule without creating an intent.

tools.name: buy_matching_service
tools.description: One-call path for a buyer agent that has explicit delegated authority for a stated allowlist of exact Zinvyl offers. Zinvyl matches one sanitized outcome and creates a bounded purchase intent only when the matched offer is allowlisted and its exact fee fits the delegated ceiling. A catalog gap or au

tools.name: buy_service
tools.description: Five-field, retry-safe agent purchase path. Creates one bounded intent only when delegated authority covers the exact fee. Reusing buyer.request_id for an unchanged purchase returns the same intent. Adaptively selects Stripe-hosted checkout by default while preserving explicit delegated-card and MPP

tools.name: recover_abandoned_purchase
tools.description: Recovers the original transaction for the same authenticated buyer, authority policy, request ID, offer, sanitized scope, amount, currency, funding route, and current terms. Before funding it resumes an expired reservation; after verified funding it safely reissues scoped order access without chargi

tools.name: create_purchase_intent
tools.description: Compatibility alias for existing clients; new integrations should use buy_service. Use only after selecting one offer when the calling agent has explicit delegated authority for that exact fixed fee. Creates the governed purchase intent and quote, then returns adaptive Stripe-hosted checkout by defa

tools.name: match_or_capture_demand
tools.description: Compatibility alias for existing clients; new integrations should use qualify_task first and find_service only after consent. Returns an existing fixed offer when one matches. Otherwise records privacy-minimized product-demand telemetry for owner review; it creates no order, quote, outreach, funding

tools.name: get_acceptance_tests
tools.description: Use after qualify_task or list_offers identifies an offer and detailed scope review is useful. Returns the exact delivery acceptance tests, exclusions, and evidence boundaries that limit what Zinvyl may claim for that offer.

tools.name: prepare_purchase_route
tools.description: Compatibility inspection alias for existing clients; new integrations should use get_purchase_requirements and buy_service. Use only after selecting an offer and confirming explicit purchasing authority. Returns the purchase-intent schema and payment-route API endpoint; it does not create, fund, ver

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "acknowledge_purchase_offer" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
